questions.q: Where was the narrator coming back from, and in what weather?
o: From Kragujevac, in late autumn, in cold rain
From a neighbouring village, in the heat
questions.e: “Vraćao sam se na konju iz Kragujevca” on a gloomy late-autumn day.

questions.q: Whom did the narrator meet by the road?
o: A boy named Mijat tending three sheep
questions.e: Little Mijat is herding three sheep.

questions.q: Why did the family have only three sheep left?
o: Two were sold to pay the tax
Two were given to a neighbour
questions.e: Their mother sold two to pay the tax.

questions.q: What was the family preparing for?
Why did Milena say she hardly had any guests?
o: No one visits the poor — everyone goes to the rich
questions.e: “All the better-off go to Miloje's; the poor don't visit the poor.”

questions.q: What did the narrator promise Milena?
o: To come to her for lunch
questions.e: “I'll come to you for lunch tomorrow.”

questions.q: What happened when the narrator entered the house the next day?
o: The boys ran out of the house
Milena hugged her son in tears and said: “Guests, my son, the mother's master of the house”
questions.e: “Gosti, sine moj, domaćine majčin…” — her voice broke.
